title: Battery recovery testing
bodyMd:
Each unit collected is tested once. Recoverable units meet a specified capacity threshold; recoverability does not specify resale value.

| Category | Collected units | Recoverable units |
|---|---:|---:|
| Portable | 80 | 40 |
| Industrial | 120 | 84 |
| Mobility | 200 | 130 |
